o.text: Derived from Proto-Turkic *dï̄n + -(n)c. Azerbaijani tıncıxmaq (“to pant”) and dincəlmək are derivations of the same root. Cognate with Turkish dinç, Bashkir тыныс (tınıs), see there for more.

Inherited from Proto-Turkic [Term?] (“throat, thrachea, cartilage”). Compare Turkish (dialectal) geğirtlek (“larynx”), Turkish (dialectal) kıkırdak (“throat”) for the vowel backing.
Cognate to Turkish gırtlak, Turkmen kekirdewük, Kyrgyz кекиртек (kekirtek), Bashkir (dialectal) кигерләк (kegirläk).
